parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot, typically made of stainless steel with a heat-resistant handle on top.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, helping to cook food evenly and efficiently.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can be lifted or placed on the pot; it is detachable and does not move independently when in place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot, made of aluminum for good heat conduction and lightweight handling.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the food and liquid during cooking, distributing heat evenly across its surface.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary during use, though it can be lifted or moved by its handles.
